notes.title: One Deck Galaxy Soundtrack Release Listening Party
notes.notes:
Today at 2:00 PM Eastern (1:00 PM Central, 12:00 Mountain, 11:00 Pacific) we'll be doing a livestream to listen to and talk about the One Deck Galaxy soundtrack, with Asmadi Games! We'll also be releasing the soundtrack afterwards. Please join us!

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/handelabragames]https://www.twitch.tv/handelabragames[/url]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes: Fixes bug whereby reshuffling the Deck, when it no longer has any Adversary Event Cards, would cause Game Over instead of Overwhelm.

notes.title: Proper Linux version
notes.notes: Updated the Linux version, as it accidently used the beta build instead of the intended release build. Whoops!

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes: This is just a patch to fix a bug in which saved games of the Hungry Nebula may not display the Swell effects when loaded.
